pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark brown polygonal regions with highly serrated, stellate margins. The edges exhibit sharp pixel-level gradients, creating a jagged interface with the surrounding light pelage. Patches are densely distributed with varying surface areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored, thin pathways that form a topological graph. Junction nodes are frequent, primarily consisting of three-way and four-way intersections. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the visible mid-flank.
